title: Kernel HLSL emitter output is not valid HLSL: C#-style GlyphOutlineInstance.SegmentCapacity / PathInstance.PathSegmentCapacity and no struct definitions
body: At kernel b1576418 (and at the previous pin) the emitted SdfCoreKernels.g.hlsl uses static member access (GlyphOutlineInstance.SegmentCapacity, line 10/12) and defines no HLSL GlyphOutlineInstance/PathInstance/PathSegment/PathPoint structs. Measured: 10 SVO tests (RecipeCodegen.*, SdfRecipeCodegen.M4*, CodegenEmit.M4d*) and the 10 RenderGraph ProceduralRecipeRenderTest fail with 'HLSL parsing failed' at shader:6 column 57 with the new pin, identical to the base. The earlier 'stale pin' attribution is wrong: the pin bump does not fix them. The fix belongs in the kernel HLSL emitter (struct definitions from the recipe-parameter block plus a valid constant form). VIXEN-side rewrite would be a deviation. Evidence: /home/liory/codeman-cases/undertow/reports/vixkpin2-evidence/ctest-svo2.log, ctest-rendergraph.log.

title: RenderGraph editor render tests fail on image thresholds under Dozen, same set as the base: 3 EditorDocumentRenderTest, AppFlowEditorToggleRenderTest
body: After the kernel pin: GoldenDocumentAllLayersRendersVisibleBody hitPixels 42082 vs 50000 (test_editor_document_render.cpp:711), DisablingCutLayerChangesTopFaceSilhouette (:812), LayeredSlabSubtractSphereGuardsAreExactAndCaptureHasHole (:980), AppFlowEditorToggleRenderTest.ToggleThenUndoRestoresRender boreDiffPixels 0 vs 3000 (test_appflow_editor_toggle_render.cpp:698). Same failing names and the same hitPixels as sn-vixleft's base run (reports/vixleft.md), so the pin and the PathInstance move did not change them and they are not the HLSL parse failure. Not isolated: Dozen versus a real shader or threshold regression is open. A native GPU run would split the two.

title: PathDistance (opcode 183) has no producer, corpus program or dedicated CPU/GPU parity test
body: RecipeGlslOpcodeCoverage.CorpusCoversEveryValidOpcode failed for 182 and 183 after the kernel pin. GlyphOutline (182) is now exempted with GlyphOutlineBucketMatchesCpu as its dedicated test; PathDistance (183) is exempted with a comment marking it a tracked gap. The generated CPU dispatch and GLSL read pathInstances[] (evalRecipe, RecipeRegistry::pathInstances and EmitProceduralFieldFunctionGlsl were plumbed through in the pin commit), but nothing in VIXEN builds a PathInstance row, so the path is untested on CPU and GPU. Add a path-row builder and a parity test, then drop the exemption.
